name: Annular Pancreas

criteria.description: Radiologic demonstration of pancreatic tissue encircling the second portion of the duodenum
Clinical or radiologic evidence of duodenal obstruction or stenosis
Symptoms or diagnosis present from neonatal period or early infancy
Exclusion of other causes of duodenal obstruction such as atresia or stenosis

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of imaging evidence of pancreatic tissue encircling the duodenum plus clinical or radiologic evidence of duodenal obstruction, with exclusion of other causes
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is primarily based on imaging modalities such as upper GI series, CT, or MRI.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Duodenal obstruction due to pancreatic ring
pathognomonic.notes: Direct result of pancreatic tissue encircling the duodenum

common.notes: Common in infants due to obstruction
Secondary to chronic obstruction and feeding difficulties
More common in older children or adults

occasional.notes: Due to biliary obstruction in some cases

rare.notes: Rarely reported due to ductal anomalies

laboratory: Elevated serum amylase and lipase during pancreatitis episodes
Possible electrolyte imbalances due to vomiting
imaging: Upper GI series showing duodenal obstruction with 'double bubble' sign
CT or MRI demonstrating pancreatic tissue encircling the duodenum
Endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography (ERCP) showing annular pancreatic duct
genetic: No specific genetic mutation identified; considered sporadic congenital anomaly
other: Surgical findings confirming pancreatic tissue ring around duodenum

distinguishingFeatures: Complete absence or closure of duodenal lumen without pancreatic tissue involvement
Typically presents with 'double bubble' sign but no pancreatic ring on imaging
Abnormal intestinal rotation causing obstruction but no pancreatic encirclement
May present with volvulus and bilious vomiting
Narrowing of duodenum without pancreatic tissue involvement

redFlags: Signs of acute pancreatitis or intestinal perforation
references: Stringer MD. Annular pancreas: congenital duodenal obstruction and beyond. J Pediatr Surg. 2012;47(11):2063-2068.
Howard ER, Landau D. Annular pancreas: a review of 33 cases. Br J Surg. 1971;58(7):515-520.
